news_items.headline: Stifel raises Ciena stock price target to $585 on AI infrastructure demand
news_items.summary: Stifel raised CIEN price target to $585 from $430, maintained Buy. Cited optical networking demand from AI infrastructure buildout; expects beat-and-raise earnings reports into mid-CY2026 across optical group.

news_items.headline: Ciena Stock On Fire: Up 15% With 5-Day Winning Streak
news_items.summary: CIEN up ~15% over a 5-day winning streak, trading near $550 (near 52-week high). Driver cited as AI-led optical networking demand from hyperscalers.

news_items.headline: BofA raises Ciena price target to $550 on backlog growth
news_items.summary: BofA Securities raised PT to $550, maintained Buy, citing backlog +$2B to $7B total tied to anticipated hyperscaler capex acceleration.

news_items.headline: Danske Bank A/S purchases 35,000 shares of Ciena Corporation
news_items.summary: Institutional filing shows Danske Bank A/S accumulated 35,000 CIEN shares.

news_items.headline: Ciena CEO sells 2,952 shares in Rule 10b5-1 trade
news_items.summary: CEO disposed 2,952 shares under a pre-arranged 10b5-1 plan. Programmatic but recorded as insider sell.

news_items.headline: Why Ciena's Stock Is Breaking Out Higher Now
news_items.summary: TipRanks catalyst note frames CIEN as a technical breakout backed by AI optical demand and recent analyst upgrades.

news_items.headline: Vodafone Idea deploys Ciena's WaveLogic 6 Extreme
news_items.summary: Vodafone Idea announced deployment of Ciena's WaveLogic 6 Extreme coherent optics platform — customer win supporting the growth narrative.

news_items.headline: Ciena demonstrates quantum secure communications with Quantum Computing Inc. at OFC 2026
news_items.summary: Joint demo of quantum-secure communications technology at OFC 2026 conference, positioning CIEN against future cybersecurity threats in optical transport.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Stifel raised PT to $585 from $430 (Buy maintained, 2026-05-05); BofA raised PT to $550 (Buy, 2026-05-05) on backlog growth. Average 1Y PT revised to $354.01 (+35.6% vs prior). 14 analysts cover with consensus Buy (11 Buy / 5 Hold / 1 Sell). Range $242.40-$493.50 (high-end PTs from Stifel/BofA exceed top of consensus range).

Multi-year drivers cited: Hyper-Rail and DCOM expansion. Recent Q1 FY2026 was a blowout with raised full-year revenue guide. Outside the 3-day forward-earnings blackout window.
